sections.funder_question: Describe the social impact your venture intends to create.
sections.plain_question: Who does your idea help, and what changes for them?
sections.text: Sightlines trains employers in how to keep and support staff who are losing their sight, using trainers who are going through it themselves. Over our first three years we expect to reach approximately 40 people newly diagnosed with sight loss, each moving from peer support into paid delivery work. Our aim is that every trainer leaves with paid hours on their CV and a reference from an employer.

gaps.note: We estimated this. Confirm before you submit.

sections.funder_question: What is the problem your venture addresses?
sections.plain_question: What is going wrong today that you want to fix?
sections.text: Young adults in Singapore who are newly diagnosed with sight loss tend to lose their footing at work at exactly the moment their employer is least equipped to keep them. The gap is not the person; it is that nobody in the workplace has been shown what to change. Sightlines closes that gap using the people it is about.
